subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should core permanently expose a current-session `resetSession(reason?)` capability to successful `after_compaction` plugin hooks across OpenClaw, Codex, and bundled Copilot lifecycles?
rationale: This adds a new plugin API with session-state authority and long-term compatibility obligations; implementation review cannot establish that product direction without an owner decision.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Approve an after-compaction-only, current-session-scoped contract after the remaining lifecycle defects, proof gap, and unrelated branch changes are resolved.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not add a plugin API; instead keep reset policy in the owning context engine or core recovery lifecycle.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer the proposal until a broader session-lifecycle API design has an owner and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Approve an after-compaction-only, current-session-scoped contract after the remaining lifecycle defects, proof gap, and unrelated branch changes are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice establishes a permanent cross-plugin session lifecycle contract and requires repository-level product ownership.
